title: ceanothus paniculatus
intro: Ceanothus paniculatus, commonly known as New Jersey tea, is a perennial shrub native to North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to act as a mild laxative and to help alleviate respiratory issues such as coughs and bronchitis. The therapeutic actions of Ceanothus paniculatus include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which can help soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
